program_solutions:
(rule!
  ;; alt: the same fold can inline bbox painting directly in the exactly-two branch.
  (let ((paint-bbox
         (lambda (out color pts)
           (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells pts))
                  (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
                  (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
             (paint-cells out (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1) color)))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)])
              ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
      (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
        (if (= (length pts) 2)
            (paint-bbox out color pts)
            out)))))
